gaps.sentence: She's not ___ to be back before midnight.
gaps.explanation: 'Be likely to do' = probable; 'probably' is an adverb and doesn't fit 'is ___ to'.

gaps.sentence: He ___ his success entirely to the teachers who believed in him.
gaps.hint: attribute something to = owe it to
gaps.explanation: 'Attribute something to something' = say it is the result of it.

gaps.sentence: She's ___ of winning a medal this season.
gaps.explanation: 'Be capable of doing' = have the ability/skill; 'able' needs 'able to do'.

gaps.sentence: The match was ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: call off = cancel; call up = phone/summon; call for = demand.

gaps.sentence: The minister has ___ a press conference for Friday morning.
The soup needs a ___ of salt to bring out the flavour.
gaps.hint: a pinch of salt = a tiny amount
gaps.explanation: 'A pinch of salt' = the small amount you hold between finger and thumb.

gaps.sentence: The jury took only two hours to reach a ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Reach a verdict' — the jury's formal decision; 'sentence' is the punishment given later.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget to ___ off the oven when you finish.
gaps.explanation: 'Turn off' (or switch off) = stop a machine.
